categories.evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and alters internal assertion logic and descriptor flag checks in CWallet and WalletBatch.

The author notes that 'since the legacy wallet can't be loaded anymore, few of these assertions are outdated now', making this a routine internal code simplification.
